devices.model: Any Crestron device that answers the CIP probe (3-Series, MC4, CP3, RMC4, DIN-AP, TSW, DM NVX)

drivers.notes: Discovery-only entry. For control, use the matching specific Crestron driver (e.g. crestron_nvx for AV-over-IP endpoints).
Validated against an M4250-40G8XF-PoE+ (software 13.0.5.14): PoE draw/control, ports, IGMP/multicast, system health, config save, and reboot exercised on hardware.
Shares the CLI per the M4250/M4350 CLI Reference Manual; not yet validated on M4350 hardware.
